Record of a long weekend
The welfare meeting began on time, with our head trainer in the chair
Attendees were Ethan Berg, Diego Haddad, and Trixie. The senior coordinator reviewed routine service choices and reminded staff to keep care plans matched to species, temperament, and comfort. The desk also checked carrier labels, feeding notes, and handover forms for clear wording, and agreed that calm handling should stay the standard for every animal in transit. Staff discussed a few minor delays caused by late owner updates, and settled on tighter follow-up through the usual channels so that each case can be prepared without confusion. The group noted that weekend traffic tends to bring mixed passenger requests, so desk messages must remain brief, accurate, and easy to trace. No unusual welfare concerns were raised, and the team was satisfied with current handling practice across Aurelia Skyways. The meeting ended in good order.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
